findings: Pilot identification is incomplete: full vs none (−7.945, n=4) and full vs strictness-only (−7.187, n=3) imply strictness-only ≈ none (about −0.76 by subtraction), so the bundled production preface is not identified as a strictness effect; the remaining unidentified factor is AI-origin-only versus an origin×strictness interaction.

n=4/3 paired inputs cannot separate a stable component effect from item-specific sensitivity; 14.4% leaf flips is a mechanism hint (rubric hijack), not a validity result; repeatability 86.8% vs 89.0% is too small and too poorly powered to be a decision metric.

Smallest decisive held-out design is a within-item 2×2 on items disjoint from the pilot: None; Strictness-only (severity language, no origin claim); Origin-only (AI-origin declaration, no extra strictness); Full production (current bundle). Same items in all arms; no between-item split.

Allocation: 12 held-out creative-writing inputs, complete factorial, two independent judge draws per cell if the judge is stochastic (96 calls). Stratify held-out items by form/length/genre so the four pilot pieces cannot dominate. Primary endpoint: the same final-point metric as the pilot. Secondary: leaf-flip rate vs None, and per-arm repeatability.

Pre-registered contrasts: Origin main effect [(Origin-only + Full) − (None + Strictness-only)]/2; Strictness main effect [(Strictness-only + Full) − (None + Origin-only)]/2; Interaction (Full − Origin-only) − (Strictness-only − None). Decision-relevant pairwise checks: Origin-only vs None (necessity of origin) and Origin-only vs Full (sufficiency of origin / inertness of adding strictness).

Stop rule: look at n=8 complete items. Stop for mechanism if (a) Origin-only vs None 95% paired CI is entirely below −4 points, (b) Origin-only vs Full CI lies inside ±3 points, and (c) Strictness-only vs None CI lies inside ±3 points. Continue to a hard cap of n=16 iff any of those fails, or if |interaction| is at least half the |origin main effect| (ambiguous mechanism). Do not peek on other metrics; do not add arms after looking.

Legitimate conclusions from this ablation only: which preface component moves this judge’s scores on held-out items; whether origin is sufficient, strictness is inert, or the bundle is non-additive; whether the pilot drop replicates off the original four inputs. Illegitimate: which preface is more correct, less biased, or closer to humans; production policy; generalization to other judges, models, or genres.
recommendations: Run the four-arm within-item 2×2 on 12 held-out inputs (two draws per cell); if budget allows only one new arm, the minimum identified set is {None, Origin-only, Full}, but that cannot re-test that strictness-only remains inert on held-out items.

Freeze preface text before scoring: Strictness-only must be a true subset of Full with origin sentences removed; Origin-only must be the origin sentences without severity add-ons; None must be empty or a length-matched inert wrapper, not a different rubric.

Analyze paired item-level deltas, not pooled means; report the three factorial contrasts with CIs; treat leaf-flip locations as a qualitative check (e.g., originality/human-likeness leaves) rather than a second primary.

Do not use human labels, do not declare a winner, and do not ship a preface change from this study alone. Use the ablation only to decide whether production’s score drop is an origin-declaration effect. Any keep/drop/rewrite of the preface needs a separate validity criterion later.
risks: Without Origin-only, a large Full vs Strictness-only gap can still be an interaction (strictness only bites after the text is labeled AI), so a two- or three-arm leftover comparison can falsely attribute the drop to origin as a main effect.
No fresh human judging means a replicated −8 point shift is not evidence of better or worse judging; it is only evidence that preface language moves the machine judge.
n=8–16 still cannot rule out genre-specific origin sensitivity; a held-out slice that resembles the four pilot inputs will overstate robustness.
Length, recency, or instruction-following confounds: if Origin-only and Strictness-only are not matched for token count and imperative tone, the contrast is linguistic, not factorial.
Judge stochasticity plus 14% leaf flips can flip a sequential stop if only one draw per cell is used; two draws are part of the stop-rule validity, not optional QA.
Repeatability 86.8% vs 89.0% will be over-interpreted if treated as a reliability win for dropping the preface; it is within noise at pilot n.
output.summary: Smallest decisive held-out ablation is a paired 2×2 on 12 new inputs (look at 8, cap 16): None, Strictness-only, Origin-only, Full. Pilot already implies strictness is nearly inert (−7.945 Full vs None on n=4; −7.187 Full vs Strictness-only on n=3), so the only unidentified causal piece is whether AI-origin alone reproduces the drop or the bundle interacts. Stop early if Origin-only vs None is < −4 with Origin-only ≈ Full and Strictness-only ≈ None. Conclude only about this judge’s score mechanics on held-out items; do not infer human-alignment or ship a preface from this study.
